evidence.note: Explicitly frames model.py as the correctness checkpoint to be created first, then copied to model_optimized.py; runs a custom parity smoke test before the official benchmark — a clear implement-then-verify ordering.

Honors the phase gate: sample-parity failure at the benchmark is diagnosed and fixed (approximate GELU, disable TF32) to establish parity BEFORE any optimization is attempted, rather than optimizing prematurely.

Optimization is run as discrete, individually scoped experiments (torch.compile; CuDNN-TF32-only; batched image encoder), each with a PASS/latency done-signal; failed experiments trigger restoring model_optimized.py from the frozen model.py, protecting the checkpoint.
Keeps the fastest passing implementation (exp3, 12% improvement), confirms the shim points at model_optimized.py, and logs the experiment trail — closing the milestone hierarchy cleanly.

reasoning: The agent clearly exceeds the level-5 anchor: it sequenced implement-full-API → verify parity → freeze model.py → optimize a copy, kept the checkpoint uncorrupted (restoring it after failed experiments), and pointed the shim at the optimized file. It approaches level 8 by treating optimization as a bounded sequence of discrete, hypothesis-driven experiments each with a PASS/latency done-condition. It falls short of 8/10 because parity milestones were end-to-end rather than per-method/per-layer, and the optimization experiments were reactive rather than a risk-ordered, pre-planned search of the ≤8 budget, placing it at 7.
